name: Bolek i Lolek
s: Two young brothers, Bolek and Lolek, play with each other, with their games being mostly inspired by films and books. Sometimes they are also accompanied by their small dog named Azorek.

paragraphs.text: Bolek and Lolek (, ), also known as Benny & Lenny, Jym & Jam, and Tim & Tom, is a 1962 children's slapstick buddy comedy animated television series created by Władysław Nehrebecki for Studio Filmów Rysunkowych. The series consists of 13 episodes, each with a running time ranching from 8 to 10 minutes. The series was distributed by Polish Television, and was originally aired from 12 August 1962 to 1 July 1964. The series was the first instalment in the franchise about two titular brothers, Bolek and Lolek. It was later followed by series Bolek and Lolek on Vacation, aired from 1965 to 1966.
Two young brothers, Bolek and Lolek, play with each other, with their games usually being inspired by films, television, and books.
